About us

Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is a serene oasis featuring a vibrant outdoor pool and full-service spa within lush gardens. Enjoy innovative cuisine at on-site restaurants. The hotel's unique architecture reflects the region's cultural essence and is ideally located near major attractions, making it perfect for exploring Bangalore's rich heritage and modern charm. In the heart of Bangalore City Center, this hotel offers two travelers easy access to vibrant cafes, markets, and cultural hotspots, blending modernity with tradition. Enjoy a refreshing indoor pool, an exclusive bar, and complimentary fruits and snacks. Rooms come with free Wi-Fi, refrigerators, invigorating showers, and some boast captivating city views. UB City’s upscale shopping and dining is within walking distance, while the Indira Gandhi Musical Fountain is just 1.3 kilometers away, ensuring an unforgettable stay. Experience Luxury and Comfort at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Welcome to Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, a luxurious 5-star hotel nestled in the heart of Bangalore, India. With its impeccable service, modern amenities, and convenient location, this hotel is the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers. Step into a world of elegance and sophistication as you enter the spacious lobby of Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru. The hotel boasts 167 beautifully designed rooms, each exuding a contemporary charm and offering a comfortable retreat after a day of exploring the city. Whether you choose a stylish Deluxe Room or opt for a more lavish Suite, you can expect nothing less than the utmost comfort and convenience. Check-in at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru begins at 2:00 PM, allowing you ample time to settle in and make yourself at home. The hotel's check-out time is at 12:00 PM, giving you the flexibility to enjoy a leisurely morning before bidding farewell to this luxurious haven. Renovated in 2016, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru showcases a modern and stylish ambiance that seamlessly blends with its rich history. The hotel is located just 3 kilometers away from the bustling city center, offering a peaceful retreat from the vibrant energy of Bangalore. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, you'll find yourself perfectly situated to explore the city's attractions, shopping districts, and culinary delights. Families traveling with young children will find Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru to be a welcoming haven. The hotel's child policy allows children between the ages of 0 to 5 to stay free of charge, ensuring a memorable and hassle-free stay for the entire family. With its prime location, luxurious accommodations, and impeccable service, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is the perfect choice for discerning travelers seeking a memorable stay in Bangalore. Experience the epitome of luxury and comfort as you indulge in the finest hospitality this city has to offer.

Experience the Vibrant Bangalore City Center

Convenient Transportation Options from the Nearest Airports to Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru, located in the heart of Bangalore City Center, offers easy accessibility from the nearest airports in Bangalore, India. If you are arriving at Kempegowda International Airport, the most convenient way to reach Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is by taking a taxi or a private car. The airport is approximately 35 kilometers away from the hotel, and the journey usually takes around 1 hour, depending on the traffic conditions. Taxis are readily available at the airport, and it is recommended to book a prepaid taxi or use ride-hailing apps for a hassle-free experience. Alternatively, if you prefer public transportation, you can take the airport shuttle bus to the city center and then transfer to a local bus or a metro to reach the hotel. The airport shuttle bus service operates at regular intervals and offers a cost-effective option for budget-conscious travelers. Once you reach the city center, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is just a short distance away. For those arriving at the domestic airport, Bangalore HAL Airport, taxis and ride-hailing services are also available for a convenient transfer to the hotel. The airport is located approximately 12 kilometers away from the hotel, and the journey time is usually around 30 minutes, depending on the traffic conditions. Whichever airport you arrive at, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is easily accessible, ensuring a seamless and comfortable journey to your destination in the heart of Bangalore City Center.

Explore the Vibrant Surroundings of Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Located in the heart of Bangalore, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru offers easy access to a host of exciting landmarks and attractions. Just a short distance away, you'll find the magnificent ISKCON Temple Bangalore, a spiritual oasis known for its stunning architecture and serene atmosphere. Immerse yourself in the beauty of nature at Cubbon Park, a sprawling green space that offers a peaceful retreat from the bustling city. For those interested in history and culture, the Visvesvaraya Industrial and Technological Museum is a must-visit. Discover fascinating exhibits and interactive displays that showcase the advancements in science and technology. Another iconic landmark in the vicinity is the Bangalore Palace, a majestic structure that transports you back in time with its intricate architecture and rich history. If you're in the mood for shopping and entertainment, head to Mahatma Gandhi (MG) Road and Commercial Street. These bustling shopping districts are home to a wide array of stores, boutiques, and restaurants, offering a vibrant atmosphere and a chance to indulge in some retail therapy. History enthusiasts will be captivated by the Tipu Sultan Fort and Palace - Bangalore KR Market, which provides a glimpse into the city's past. Marvel at the elaborate carvings and intricate designs that adorn this historic site. For a taste of modern architecture, visit the iconic Vidhana Soudha and Attara Kacheri, the seat of the state legislature and high court. Sports fans can catch a cricket match at the M Chinnaswamy Stadium, a renowned venue that has hosted numerous international matches. And for a spiritual experience, the ISKCON Bangalore and Sri Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Temple offer a tranquil setting for meditation and reflection. With its prime location and proximity to these captivating landmarks and attractions, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru ensures that guests can truly immerse themselves in the vibrant culture and rich heritage of Bangalore.

Convenient Public Transport Stations near Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru

Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is strategically located near several public transport stations, making it easy for guests to explore Bangalore and its surroundings. The hotel is within close proximity to Attiguppe, Nayandahalli, and Mysore Road stations, providing convenient access to the city's extensive bus network. From these stations, guests can easily reach popular attractions, shopping districts, and business centers in Bangalore. For those traveling by train, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is also conveniently located near several railway stations. The hotel is a short distance away from Deepanjali Nagar, Srirampura, Rajajinagar, and Kempegowda Bus Station, providing easy access to the city's railway network. Guests can easily travel to other cities in India or explore the beautiful state of Karnataka. Additionally, the hotel is also close to Jnanabharati, KSR Station Back Entrance, and Cantonment Railway Station, making it a convenient choice for both business and leisure travelers. These stations offer easy access to Bangalore's major transportation hubs, allowing guests to explore the city and its surroundings with ease. Whether guests prefer to travel by bus or train, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru's prime location ensures a hassle-free and enjoyable stay.

A Gastronomic Delight in the Vicinity

Located in the heart of Bangalore, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru offers easy access to a plethora of dining options. Just a short stroll away, you'll find popular local eateries such as Brahmins' Coffee Bar, Empire Restaurant Majestic, and Hotel Empire - Central Street. These establishments are renowned for their delicious South Indian delicacies, aromatic coffee, and mouthwatering biryanis. For those seeking a more upscale dining experience, Nagarjuna Restaurant on Residency Road offers delectable Andhra cuisine, while Empire Restaurant Rajajinagar is known for its sumptuous North Indian fare. Additionally, food enthusiasts can explore the vibrant Church Street Social, a trendy eatery offering a fusion of global cuisines and a lively ambiance. If you're in the mood for some juicy burgers and wings, Leon's Burgers & Wings in Rajajinagar is a must-visit. For a taste of authentic Karnataka cuisine, head to Hallimane Restaurant or Slv Corner Restaurant, both located nearby. Sattvam Restaurant, known for its pure vegetarian fare, is also a great option for those seeking a satiating meal. With such a diverse range of culinary experiences just steps away, guests at Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru are spoilt for choice.

Shop Till You Drop at Bangalore's Best Shopping Landmarks

Located in the heart of Bangalore, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru offers easy access to some of the city's most popular shopping landmarks. Just a stone's throw away, you'll find GT World Mall, a shopper's paradise with a wide range of international and local brands. For those looking for traditional Indian clothing and accessories, Fabindia is a must-visit, offering a stunning collection of handcrafted items. If you're in the mood for bargain hunting, head to Chickpet, a bustling market known for its affordable clothing and textiles. Music lovers will be delighted to explore Planet M, a renowned music store with an extensive collection of CDs and DVDs. Bookworms can lose themselves in the enchanting world of literature at Blossom Book House, a charming bookstore filled with rare and second-hand books. Fashion enthusiasts will love browsing through the trendy collections at Cinnamon, Ffolio, and Max Fashion, all located within a short distance from the hotel. For a taste of local culture and flavors, a visit to Gandhi Bazaar is a must, where you can explore an array of traditional Indian spices, handicrafts, and street food. And if you're still craving more retail therapy, Sigma Mall is just a short drive away, offering a wide range of international and Indian brands. With such a diverse range of shopping options at your doorstep, Radisson Blu Atria Bengaluru is the perfect base for a memorable shopping experience in Bangalore.

What guests liked

Summarized by AI

•General Services: Courteous, helpful service stands out, with staff handling requests well and keeping interactions warm across the front desk, housekeeping, and restaurant. (12 mentions)

•Location: Central Bengaluru location makes it easy to get around, with Cubbon Park, Chinnaswamy, UB City mall, and other city spots close by. (10 mentions)

•Breakfast: Breakfast gets strong praise for taste and variety, with reviews mentioning a wide buffet spread, many fruits, sweets, juices, and good coffee. (10 mentions)

•Room Cleanliness: Clean, tidy rooms and spotless bathrooms come up often, with several reviews describing the rooms as well maintained and hygienic. (10 mentions)

•Value for Money: Value for money comes through in several reviews, especially for the central location, clean rooms, facilities, and overall quality at the rate paid. (8 mentions)

•On-site Restaurant: On-site dining earns praise for good food, with reviews highlighting the restaurant and in-room dining as enjoyable parts of the stay. (7 mentions)
